specialists.name: TASK_REQUIREMENTS
specialists.question: Which message first departs from a requirement or constraint in the original task, if any? Identify the earliest supported departure rather than a later consequence.

specialists.name: EVIDENCE_SUPPORT
specialists.question: Which message first makes an unsupported claim or inference that matters to the failed outcome, if any? Distinguish an originating inference from its repetition.

specialists.name: TOOL_USE
specialists.question: Which message first chooses or uses a tool in a way that causes the failed outcome, if any? Check the available tool results before attributing the error.

specialists.name: HANDOFF_CONSISTENCY
specialists.question: Which message first passes incorrect, missing, or inconsistent information between agents, if any? Separate the original defect from downstream reliance on it.

specialists.name: PLAN_EXECUTION
specialists.question: Which message first commits the attempt to an incorrect plan or execution step that is causally necessary for failure, if any?

specialists.name: CAUSAL_TIMELINE
specialists.question: Across the ordered messages, where does the decisive causal mistake first appear, if any? Compare candidate origins with later symptoms and corrections.
